sloka: शूरो ऽहमिति चात्मानमवगच्छसि दुर्मते ।नैव लज्जा ऽस्ति ते सीतां चोरवद् व्यपकर्षतः ।। ६.१०५.१७ ।।
transliteration: śūro 'hamiti cātmānamavagacchasi durmate ।naiva lajjā 'sti te sītāṁ coravad vyapakarṣataḥ ।। 6.105.17 ।।

translations.english: "O Evil minded fellow! You boast yourself as a hero, while you abducted Sita like a thief. Shame did not stand in your way."
